subject: history

items.q: Did Elizabeth I marry to secure her throne?
items.correct: No — she never married, becoming the 'Virgin Queen'.
items.misconception: Yes, she married a foreign prince.
items.why: Elizabeth used the prospect of marriage diplomatically but stayed single.

items.q: Why was the Spanish Armada (1588) defeated?
items.correct: A combination of weather, fireships, English tactics and Spanish problems.
items.misconception: Only because English ships were bigger.
items.why: No single factor; the 'Protestant wind' and fireships were important alongside seamanship.

items.q: Was Elizabethan England free of religious tension?
items.correct: No — religion was a central issue; Elizabeth sought a 'middle way' but faced plots.
items.why: The Religious Settlement tried to balance tensions, but recusancy and plots continued.
